title: Staging: staff stay staff after the privacy strip
why: Jason, 2026-11-14: on staging his account menu showed only his personal account (live shows Traversence staff TRV-0001, his personal account and M2 ServCore). Opening staging from the live admin signs in as the staff login's own record, and the strip rewrote its marker address (@staff.traversence.invalid), so the site no longer knew it as a staff login or found its linked member account. The marker isn't anyone's personal address, so the strip keeps it. Takes effect at staging's next refresh.
